b: Irvine, CA, November 17, 2026 — Hisong has announced AirStudio Muse, a pocket-sized recording system that combines a microphone, wireless monitoring, and an audio interface in a single device. It is the latest entry in the company's AirStudio line, following the AirStudio S1 launched last year.

AirStudio Muse includes 64GB of built-in storage, a pair of low-latency wireless monitoring earbuds, and one-button recording. Hisong is aiming it at singers, musicians, songwriters, music educators, and content creators.

Capturing a demo-ready idea typically requires a microphone, an audio interface, headphones, cables, and a laptop. AirStudio Muse reduces that to a single button: press record, and the take is saved automatically for instant playback or later retrieval.

Onboard features include a microphone switchable between enhanced dynamic and condenser modes; ZeroSync wireless monitoring, with low-latency earbuds that store and charge inside the device; VocalSense technology, which optimizes vocal pickup and reduces background noise; USB-C connectivity; an integrated wireless audio receiver for video content; and real-time effects processing via the free Hisong Link app.

AirStudio Muse's onboard DualTrack feature records two tracks without an external device or app, allowing users to add accompaniment or harmony parts. The unit also ships with a licensed copy of Steinberg Cubase LE, so tracks can be moved into a larger DAW project for overdubbing or mixing.

"The most important tool for any creative process is the idea. Five pieces of gear and minutes of setup is where most ideas go to die," said Carlos Ye, CEO of Hisong. "With AirStudio Muse, we introduce a purpose-built tool meant to capture your idea before it disappears. Now, singers, musicians, and other professionals of all skill levels are able to experience high-quality recording in an economical manner, while eliminating the hassle of a complicated recording setup."
FlashCapture: Press the physical REC button to start recording, and press it again to stop and save. Takes are saved directly to 64GB of built-in storage.

ZeroSync wireless monitoring: A low-latency wireless audio system delivers real-time monitoring through earbuds stored and charged in the device, while sending the same audio to connected receivers for recording, livestreaming, or live sound.
VocalSense 2.0: Users can switch between Enhanced Dynamic mode, for focused vocals with less background noise in loud environments, and Condenser mode, for more vocal detail in quiet settings.
Onboard DualTrack: Records an independent vocal track and backing track on the device. Files export to any DAW through USB Drive Mode, and every box includes a Steinberg Cubase LE activation card.

Connectivity: Works as a USB-C audio interface for iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS. The wireless receiver sends audio to compatible USB-C devices for recording or livestreaming, and one-tap vocal effects are adjustable in the Hisong Link app.
Audio export: 24-bit/48kHz default; up to 32-bit float/96kHz*
Monitoring: ZeroSync wireless earbuds, 13mm dynamic drivers
The AirStudio Muse Standard Pack is available for a street price of $399. The Universal Wireless Audio Receiver is sold separately for $99. For more information visit hisong.io.

Audio hardware and software innovator HISONG has unveiled its revolutionary content capture system, AirStudio Muse. As the latest entry in the company’s AirStudio line, and following the success of the multi-award winning AirStudio S1, launched last year, AirStudio Muse combines a professional microphone, wireless monitoring, and an audio interface in a single pocket-sized device.
